_meta.description: Per-neighborhood challenge decks for Paint the Town, Jet Lag: The Game style. Each of the 77 Chicago community areas has a deck of challenges grounded in real, verified local landmarks. Drawn when a team claims/captures that area. type: photo|trivia|measure|physical|find|riddle. difficulty: 1 (quick) .. 3 (effortful). restriction: optional Jetlag-style constraint.

1.title: Mile of Murals
1.prompt: Find any mural along the Glenwood Ave 'Mile of Murals' between the Morse and Loyola Red Line stops and read its painted title aloud.

1.title: Lakefront from a beach
1.prompt: Take a photo standing on the sand at any of Rogers Park's lakefront beaches (e.g. Loyola, Pratt, or Hartigan) with the water behind you.
1.restriction: No one else may appear in frame

1.title: Jesuit lakeside chapel
1.prompt: At Loyola's lakeside campus, name the Art Deco chapel facing the lake. Verify the answer is Madonna della Strada.
